note: V4B empirical measurements. Distinct from V3 roller/greeks wrappers.

families.name: market_delta_1m
families.definition: Signed close-to-close home yes_bid_close change over the configured interval.
families.formula: K_t - K_{t-1} in integer E4; null unless interval_seconds == expected_interval_seconds

families.name: fundamental_delta
families.definition: Change in prior-only F between independently constructed cutoffs.
families.formula: F_t_e4 - F_{t-1,e4} exact rational; each F from db.fundamental at its own observation_id

families.name: response_delta
families.definition: Observed market movement minus modeled fundamental movement.

families.name: market_fundamental_basis
families.definition: Exact E4-scaled K_t - F_t. Distinct from V3 basis.py NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED.

families.name: basis_delta
families.definition: Change in basis across the same interval as market_delta_1m.

families.name: score_delta
families.definition: Fundamental E4 change per unit home-minus-away score differential change.
families.formula: ΔF_t / ΔS_t where S = home - away; null if ΔS = 0

families.name: discrete_gamma
families.definition: Temporal second difference of sequential fundamental deltas. Not score-surface curvature.

families.name: theta_observed
families.definition: Fundamental E4 change per elapsed game-clock second.

families.name: pure_theta
families.definition: theta_observed when period and S are unchanged. PARTIAL. Not no-event theta.
families.formula: theta_observed if period and S held else MIXED_INTERVAL

families.name: candle_range
families.definition: High minus low on the latest visible home candle.

families.name: absolute_return
families.definition: Unsigned E4 movement. Not a second signed market delta.

families.name: realized_market_volatility
families.definition: Rolling sum of absolute close-to-close movement. Absolute-variation proxy, not IV or stdev.
families.formula: sum |K_i - K_{i-1}| over configured visible closes

families.name: directional_efficiency
families.definition: Absolute open-to-close over high-low on the latest visible home candle.

families.name: v4b_baseline
families.definition: E[M | core_v1] over other games with measurement_available_at_i < t.
families.formula: exact rational mean of eligible historical measurements

families.name: v4b_residual
families.definition: M - E[M | core_v1]. Insufficient support is null, not 0.
families.formula: R = M - expected; standardized only if MAD > 0
